sections.name: INTRODUCTION
sentences: This is a civil action.

Pursuant to Local Civil Rule 53.2, § 3(c)(2), the undersigned counsel of record or pro se plaintiff hereby certifies that to the best of his knowledge and belief, the damages recoverable in this civil action case exceed the sum of $150,000.00 exclusive of interest and costs.

sections.name: JURISDICTION AND VENUE
sentences: This is a civil action.
Pursuant to 28 U.S.C. § 1331, jurisdiction is based on federal question.
Venue is proper in this district under 28 U.S.C. § 1391(b) because a substantial part of the events or omissions giving rise to the claim occurred in this district.

sections.name: PARTIES
sentences: The plaintiff is Alicia Longo.
The defendant is David M. Koller, counsel for the plaintiff.
This case originated in the state court and was removed to federal court.

sections.name: CASE MANAGEMENT TRACK DESIGNATION
sentences: Counsel for the plaintiff has designated this case as a "Standard Management" case under Local Civil Rule 53.2.

sections.name: CIVIL JUSTICE EXPENSE AND DELAY REDUCTION PLAN
sentences: In accordance with the Civil Justice Expense and Delay Reduction Plan of this court, counsel for the plaintiff shall complete a Case Management Track Designation Form in all civil cases at the time of filing the complaint and serve a copy on all defendants.

sections.name: CERTIFICATION OF ARBITRATION
sentences: The undersigned counsel of record or pro se plaintiff hereby certifies that to the best of his knowledge and belief, this case is not required to be designated for arbitration under Local Civil Rule 53.2.

sections.name: RELATED CASES
sentences: There are no related cases in this court.

sentences: The undersigned counsel of record or pro se plaintiff hereby certifies that to the best of his knowledge and belief, this case is not required to be designated for arbitration under Local Civil Rule 53.2.
